balance.decrepify: Start 0%, +3 percentage points per second before existing 5% synergies; 90% cap, all-target frame pump and immunity penalty retained. Noncombat metadata guarantees zero-strength state attaches.
balance.plague_infection: 10% poison damage per hard point, same sources; spread helper matches manual Infection.
balance.infection_death: 33% corpse base-life explosion, min=max; radius, half physical/fire split and guaranteed spread unchanged.
balance.attract: 8% synergy sources Confuse, Decrepify, Infection; replaces Lower Resist in helper damage formulas and tooltip.
balance.elemental: All fire/cold/lightning base and level damage halved by reducing HitShift one bit; existing 15% synergies, 3-second fire cadence, cold duration/radius and lightning jumps retained.
